title: Protocols for endothelial cell isolation from mouse tissues: brain, choroid, lung, and muscle
protocol: Prepare enzyme mix 1 by mixing 5.7 mL of buffer X with 150 μL of enzyme P from the Neural Tissue Dissociation kit (P).
Equilibrate enzyme mix 1 to 37°C.
Perform transcardial perfusion via the left ventricle with ice-cold PBS at a rate of 2 mL/min for 5 min.
Remove the brain surgically.
Place the brain in ice-cold DMEM supplemented with 1× penicillin/streptomycin.
Transfer the dissected brain to a Petri dish chilled on ice.
Mince the tissue with a scalpel blade until no more large pieces remain.
Transfer the brain pieces to a 15 mL conical tube using a cut P1000 pipette tip.
Mix the brain pieces with enzyme mix 1.
Incubate for 17 min at 37°C on a tube rotator (max. 20 rpm).
Prepare enzyme mix 2 by mixing buffer Y and enzyme A.
Add enzyme mix 2 to the cell suspension from the incubation.
Mix the suspension with a Pasteur pipette by pipetting up and down 10 times.
If clogging occurs, remove it by tapping the tip of the Pasteur pipette against the bottom of the conical tube until resolved.
Ensure the suspension passes through the Pasteur pipette without clogging.
Incubate for 12 min at 37°C with slow rotation (10 rpm) on a tube rotator.
Pass the cell suspension firmly through a 20G needle approximately 10 times without creating bubbles or foam.
Incubate the cell suspension for an additional 10 minutes at 37°C with slow rotation (10 rpm) on the tube rotator.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL conical tube and add 40 mL of ice-cold HBSS containing Mg2+, Ca2+.
Filter the mixture through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 50 mL conical tube and keep the pellet at 4°C.
Repeat steps 2n, 2o, and this step two more times for a total of three cycles of centrifugation.
Resuspend pellets from previous steps in 3600 μL Wash Buffer.
Add 400 μL Myelin Removal Beads II to the resuspended pellet.
Mix thoroughly and incubate at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Add Wash Buffer to reach a total volume of 40 mL after bead addition.
Centrifuge the mixture at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4°C, then remove the supernatant.
Prepare 3 collection tubes and LS columns according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Place each column in a suitable magnetic separator.
Rinse each column with 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Resuspend the pellet in 6 mL of Wash Buffer.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension onto each column.
Collect eluent containing cells after the suspension runs through the column.
Wash the column twice by adding 1 mL of Wash Buffer once the reservoir is empty, collecting the eluent.
Repeat the procedure for the remaining sample using another 3 LS columns.
Centrifuge the total eluent at 300 g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged samples.
Pool the pellets in 2 mL of Wash Buffer and centrifuge again at 300 g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer.
Add the appropriate volume of CD31 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Resuspend cells in 90 μL of Wash Buffer.
Determine the cell number.
For up to 1 × 10^7 total cells, add 10 μL of CD31 MicroBeads.
If fewer than 1 × 10^7 cells are available, use the same volumes as indicated above.
Filter through a 40 μm cell strainer if the sample is too viscous or contains clumps.
Mix well and incubate for 20 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Prepare collection tubes according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Rinse MS columns with 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer and place them in a magnetic separator.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto the prepared MS column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash the MS column 3 times with 0.5 mL Wash Buffer.
Add buffer to the column once the reservoir is empty during each wash.
Remove the MS column from the separator and place it onto a new 15 mL conical collection tube.
Pipette 1 mL Wash Buffer onto the MS column.
Firmly apply the plunger supplied with the column to flush out the fraction containing magnetically labeled cells (CD31-positive fraction).
Prepare unstained cell (US) control for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare viability control (VB) for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare Fluorescence Minus One (FMO) control for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Optional: Prepare isotype controls for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare compensation controls for each fluorophore using compensation beads (e.g., OneComp eBeads™ Compensation Beads).
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μL Wash Buffer-based staining solution containing CD31 (PECAM-1) Monoclonal Antibody, CD45 Monoclonal Antibody, and Viability Dye.
Stain the cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of Wash Buffer and centrifuge the stained cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in Wash Buffer.
Proceed with FACS.
Sort viable, CD45-/CD31+ cells to collection tubes.
Sort the ECs to an Eppendorf tube containing collection medium.
Sacrifice mice by cervical dislocation and collect eyes by inserting scissors along the eye into the orbital cavity.
Cut the four optical muscles and the optic nerve behind the eye.
Remove periocular tissue under a microscope after placing the eyes in PBS.
Dissect the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE)-choroid-sclera complex from enucleated eyes by peeling off the vitreous body and retina.
Transfer dissected choroids to a 50 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of choroid digestion buffer.
Pipette the choroids vigorously using a P1000 micropipette.
Incubate in a 37°C water bath for 30–40 min.
Pipette the choroids vigorously every 5–10 min during incubation.
Add 5 mL of Wash Buffer to stop the enzymatic reaction.
Filter cells through a 100 μm cell strainer into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the used conical tube with an additional 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Filter the suspension through the 100 μm cell strainer.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Wash the cells with 5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer.
Add the appropriate volume of CD45 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Prepare collection tubes and MS columns according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Place the column in the suitable magnetic separator.
Rinse the column with 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Rinse MS columns with 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto the prepared MS column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash the MS column 3 times with 0.5 mL Wash Buffer, adding buffer each time once the column reservoir is empty.
Collect the eluent from steps 8f and 8g in the conical tube.
Centrifuge the total eluent (CD45-negative fraction) at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer.
Add the appropriate volume of CD31 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Process quickly to avoid non-specific binding of beads at 20°C–22°C.
Wash cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto prepared MS columns through a 40 μm cell strainer to remove potential cell aggregates.
Wash the MS column 3 times with 0.5 mL Wash Buffer, adding buffer each time once the reservoir is empty.
Remove the MS column from the separator and place it onto a new 15 mL conical collection tube.
Pipette 1 mL Wash Buffer onto the MS column.
Flush out the fraction containing magnetically labeled cells by firmly applying the plunger supplied with the column.
Prepare all required controls for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Include unstained cell (US) control.
Include viability control (VB).
Include Fluorescence Minus One (FMO) control.
Optional: Include isotype controls.
For each fluorophore, prepare compensation controls using compensation beads.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μL Wash Buffer-based staining solution containing CD31 (PECAM-1) Monoclonal Antibody, CD45 Monoclonal Antibody, and Viability Dye.
Stain the cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of Wash Buffer to stained cells.
Centrifuge the stained cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged stained cells.
Resuspend the pellet in Wash Buffer.
Proceed with FACS analysis.
Sort viable, CD45-/CD31+ cells to collection tubes.
Prepare lung digestion buffer right before isolation.
Add supplemented KnockOutTM DMEM-medium, 0.1% (w/v) Collagenase II, 0.25% (w/v) Collagenase IV, and 15 μg/mL DNase I to the buffer.
Store freshly prepared lung digestion buffer at 4°C until needed.
Perform transcardial perfusion via the right ventricle with ice-cold PBS at a rate of 2 mL/min for 5 minutes.
Dissect the lungs and cut them into single lobes using small scissors or a scalpel blade.
Rinse the lung lobes on a Petri dish with ice-cold PBS.
Place lung lobes from one mouse in a gentleMACS C tube with 5 mL of lung digestion buffer.
Close the tube tightly and keep it on ice.
Run m_lung_01 protocol (pre-programmed by manufacturer) in MACS Dissociator.
Incubate sample in digestion buffer in a 37°C water bath for 30 minutes, shaking vigorously every 5 minutes.
Run m_lung_02 protocol (pre-programmed by manufacturer).
Filter the sample through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the strainer with 5 mL Wash buffer using a P1000 micropipette and transfer the filtered suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 g for 5 minutes, then remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL Wash Buffer by pipetting up and down using a P1000 micropipette.
Centrifuge the cell suspension again at 250 g for 5 minutes and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer.
Add the appropriate volume of CD45 MicroBeads and EpCAM MicroBeads according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix well.
Incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Prepare collection tubes and LS columns according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Place the column in the suitable magnetic separator and rinse with 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto a prepared LS column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Collect the unlabeled cells (the eluent) in a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash the LS column 3 times with 3 mL Wash Buffer, adding buffer each time once the column reservoir is empty.
Collect eluent from steps into the conical tube.
Centrifuge the total eluent at 250 g for 5 min, remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer and add CD31 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Resuspend cells in 90 μL of Wash Buffer.
Determine the cell number.
For up to 1 × 10^7 total cells, add 10 μL of CD31 MicroBeads.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto a prepared LS column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Collect the unlabeled cells (the eluent) in a 15 mL conical tube (CD31-negative fraction).
Wash the LS column 3 times with 3 mL Wash Buffer, adding buffer each time once the column reservoir is empty.
Remove the LS column from the separator and place it onto a new 15 mL conical collection tube.
Pipette 5 mL Wash Buffer onto the LS column.
Firmly apply the plunger supplied with the column to flush out the fraction containing the magnetically labeled cells (CD31-positive fraction).
Prepare unstained cell (US) control for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare viability control (VB) for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare Fluorescence Minus One (FMO) control for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Optionally, prepare isotype controls for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare compensation controls for each fluorophore using compensation beads.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL Wash Buffer-based staining solution containing CD31 (PECAM-1) Monoclonal Antibody, CD45 Monoclonal Antibody, and Viability Dye.
Stain cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge the stained cells at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in Wash Buffer.
Proceed with FACS.
Sort viable, CD45-/CD31+ cells to collection tubes.
Sort ECs to an Eppendorf tube containing collection medium (10% v/v FBS in PBS).
Optionally add an antibody against CD326 (EpCAM) to the staining panel for epithelial cell depletion efficiency determination.
Prepare muscle digestion buffer containing PBS, collagenase IV, dispase, and CaCl2 right before isolation.
Store the freshly prepared muscle digestion buffer at 4°C until needed.
Digest muscle tissue without prior transcardial perfusion.
Enrich endothelial cells using CD31 murine MicroBeads.
Perform FACS to sort live/CD45-/CD31+ cells from EDL and soleus muscles.
Dissect soleus muscle from tendon to tendon.
Dissect EDL muscle from tendon to tendon.
Place dissected muscles in an ice-cold Petri dish with 1 mL of muscle digestion buffer.
Cut the muscles into pieces until a homogenous paste-like slurry is formed.
Add 9 mL of digestion buffer per 16 muscles to the sample and transfer into a 15 mL conical tube.
Rotate the conical tube at 12 rpm for 45 minutes at 37°C.
Pipette up and down every 15 minutes with a Pasteur pipette during rotation.
Add 10 mL of wash buffer to stop digestion after rotating.
Filter the sample through a 70 μm cell strainer, then through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the filtered sample at 300 g for 20 minutes.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged sample.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer.
Add the appropriate volume of CD31 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Prepare collection tubes and MS columns according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Place the column in the suitable magnetic separator.
Rinse the column with 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Remove the supernatant from the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of Wash Buffer.
Apply the cell suspension to the prepared MS column.
Collect the unlabeled cells (the eluent) in a 15 mL conical tube (CD31-negative fraction).
Wash the MS column 3 times with 0.5 mL Wash Buffer, adding buffer each time once the column reservoir is empty.
Place the MS column onto a new 15 mL conical collection tube.
Pipette 1 mL of Wash Buffer onto the MS column.
Firmly apply the plunger supplied with the column to flush out the fraction containing the magnetically labeled cells (CD31-positive fraction).
Prepare unstained cell (US) control for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare viability control (VB) for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare Fluorescence Minus One (FMO) control for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
(Optional) Prepare isotype controls for flow cytometry analysis beforehand.
Prepare compensation controls (one for each fluorophore) for proper set up of the cytometer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μL Wash Buffer-based staining solution containing CD31 (PECAM-1) Monoclonal Antibody, CD45 Monoclonal Antibody, and Viability Dye.
Stain the cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of Wash Buffer and centrifuge the stained cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in Wash Buffer.
Proceed with FACS to sort viable, CD45-/CD31+ cells to collection tubes.
